==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Santo:''' Septimont is importing large quantities of Ragunna spices and alabaster. It seems we've chosen the perfect time to enter the market.
:'''Naldo:''' Lucky for us, the Order relaxed trade restrictions around the Carnevale. Without that, this deal might've been a gamble.
:'''Naldo:''' Who knows how long these good days will last...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Santo:''' Hello, are you here to do business with the Montelli family as well?
:{{DIcon}} Something like that.
:{{DIcon}} I'm actually a member of the family.
:'''Santo:''' The Montelli are sharp with coin, but they honor their word. Good business partners, if you can trust them.
:'''Santo:''' Is that so? Guess that means you're a high rank. Most of the staff are stuck in those drab uniforms.
:'''Santo:''' We're brothers traveling between Ragunna and Septimont. We deal in commodities, art auctions, and, of course, high-stakes competitions.
:'''Santo:''' Perhaps one day, we'll find ourselves working together on a venture.
{{Dialogue End}}
